g.text: Where to catch your bus on High Street, High Wycombe

Stop letters are those printed on the stop itself (NaPTAN); services from the Bus Open Data Service.
Every bus here also calls at the bus station, 600 m north-west; on this sheet you board on the street, in the direction you are going.
Not indexed: school and works journeys (1S, 36S, 37M, 643, 654) and the WW1 shuttle to Adams Park.
Town buses that stay inside High Wycombe (27, 32, 32A and 33) are not listed: this sheet indexes places outside the town.
